title: MELD-Na Score

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: coefficients 3.78/11.2/9.57/6.43 confirmed as the OPTN 2016 form (0.957/0.378/1.120/0.643) ×10; lab floors/caps and Na bounds verified. Removed verify-coefficients flag. Known deviation (Na term applied always, no 6-40 clamp) kept in the build note.
Initial entry — formula transcribed from Calculator_Logic_Build_Spec.md.

purpose: Liver disease severity — 90-day mortality estimate, transplant allocation priority, and perioperative risk in cirrhosis.
notes: Cap rules baked into the formula: bilirubin, INR, and creatinine each floored at 1.0; creatinine also capped at 4.0 (use 4.0 if on dialysis ≥ 2× in the past week). Sodium bounded to 125-137 before the correction. Enter raw lab values.

formulas.label: MELD-Na
formulas.expression: (3.78 * ln(max(bilirubin, 1)) + 11.2 * ln(max(inr, 1)) + 9.57 * ln(min(max(creatinine, 1), 4)) + 6.43) + 1.32 * (137 - min(max(na, 125), 137)) - (0.033 * (3.78 * ln(max(bilirubin, 1)) + 11.2 * ln(max(inr, 1)) + 9.57 * ln(min(max(creatinine, 1), 4)) + 6.43) * (137 - min(max(na, 125), 137)))

buildNote: The MELD sub-expression is inlined twice because the formula engine evaluates each formula against inputs only, not against other formula results. Verify the whole thing against MDCalc / OPTN before go-live (flag: verify-coefficients). Some implementations skip the sodium correction when MELD ≤ 11.
